method: Model projection, simulation not run (100k engine is on the user's Mac); no prop lines compared yet. Team plays = season plays/g x (1+0.5*(implied total/season pts -1)), capped +/-8%; pass rate = season rate +/-3 pts by 10G script (+/-5 at 7+ pt spread). Player targets = pass att x (0.6 L3 + 0.4 season target share); carries = rush att x blended carry share. Receptions = targets x catch rate x defense catch-rate multiplier (0.92-1.08 vs league for that position); rec yds = targets x yds/target x defense yds/target multiplier (0.85-1.15); rush yds = carries x YPC x defense RB YPC multiplier (0.85-1.15). Low/high = median scaled by the player's own 25th/75th percentile game (rush+rec yds) Wks 1-7. Gate: WR/TE 3+ tgt/g season or L3; RB 5+ car/g or 2+ tgt/g. Top 3 WR, top TE, top 2 RB always shown, tagged if they fail.
